description: This file provides utility functions for parsing command-line arguments related to Vitest reports, loading JSON reports from specified paths, and formatting milliseconds. It includes functions for argument parsing, report loading, and formatting, focusing on test report processing.

methods.name: parseVitestReportArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments related to Vitest report configuration, with default values.

methods.name: loadVitestReportFromArgs
methods.description: Loads a Vitest JSON report from arguments, utilizing report path and prefix.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a millisecond value into a string with specified decimal digits.
